title: Reporting MCL Injuries
note: Generated by tools/positions.py --extract from the page itself. Edit the verification, kind, signed_off_by and note fields; everything else is rewritten on the next extraction. The detector over collects on purpose: mark anything that is teaching rather than clinical direction as NOT_CLINICAL rather than deleting it.

positions.as_written: Assess the superficial and the deep layer as separate structures on coronal images.
State the site along the ligament: femoral, mid substance or tibial.
Assess the posterior oblique ligament and the rest of the posteromedial corner explicitly.
Report whether the medial meniscus is attached to the deep layer or separated from it.
Report the associated cruciate injury, because an isolated grade means little beside a combined one.
